ai.title: BITS Pilani gives UG students more flexibility with new AI-era curriculum

ai.description_cn: BITS Pilani已经对本科课程进行了修订，增加了新的课程、研究方向以及基于实际经验的实践活动。这一改革是为了应对人工智能日益增强的影响力，以及人们对学生心理健康问题的担忧。

ai.title: To make artificial intelligence morally good, tech cos turn to religion
ai.description: As tech companies race to build the most powerful artificial intelligence, some are also asking how to teach a chatbot right from wrong. Their answer, Religion.
ai.title_cn: 为了让人工智能在道德上变得“善良”，科技公司常常借助宗教的理念来达成这一目的。

ai.title: Rogue Chinese bots: Why AI doesn't have to be evil to cause chaos-and why that's a global problem
ai.description: It turns out artificial intelligence agents going 'off-script' is not just a quirk of bots made by American firms like OpenAI and Anthropic. Agents running on China's biggest tech company's cloud server went rogue—that should tell us this is a worldwide issue. We need more openness from AI makers.
ai.title_cn: 无良的中国机器人：为什么人工智能不一定非得是邪恶的，从而引发混乱——这其实是一个全球性问题
ai.description_cn: 事实证明，人工智能代理违反脚本行为并非只有像OpenAI和Anthropic这样的美国公司所开发的机器人才会出现的问题。在中国最大的科技公司的云服务器上运行的人工智能代理也出现了类似的情况——这表明这是全球性的问题。我们需要更多来自人工智能领域的企业展现出更高的开放性。
